references.usage: Separate capture and tip-discharge controls; upright emptying directly into a collection vessel. Our blue linear intake and orange sliding floor are original geometry, not an OEM replica.

mechanism: Two independent constant passive spring-return native prismatic joints. GateSlide: +Z,0..50mm,25N/m,rest-20mm. BottomSlide: -X,0..58mm,20N/m,rest-50mm. Each has2Ns/m damping and0.03 friction. Both are driven only by robot contact; no suction, state writes, switched springs, latches or fixture motors. Controller reads elapsed time and ordinary robot joints.
